registry_basis.import_avoided_because: main does not carry the registry loader or data; facts are transcribed, not imported, so nothing here breaks CI on main.

binding_blocker.statement: A matched-resource contract must pin model, tool/retrieval stack, budget and evaluator. Those architecture fields read CANNOT_CHECK for every eligible system because entries rest on search snippets. A matched contract cannot be specified from CANNOT_CHECK fields.
binding_blocker.consequence: Adapter scoping is DOWNSTREAM of primary-text reads, not parallel to them. An adapter written now would encode guessed architecture and produce exactly the confound the comparator-class rule exists to prevent.

second_gate_not_pinned_by_registry_v1.name: task_population_compatibility
second_gate_not_pinned_by_registry_v1.statement: comparator_class answers whether a system's confounders can be matched. It does not answer whether the system can attempt the task population at all. The two are independent.
second_gate_not_pinned_by_registry_v1.worked_example: SYS-MINI_SWE_AGENT is ARCHITECTURE_CAUSAL_ELIGIBLE but is class B only (scientific-execution/code). TAXONOMY.md routes class B to ScienceAgentBench / PhySciBench / AARRI-Bench, never to AutoResearchBench or DeepResearch Bench, so it cannot enter a literature-route arm.
second_gate_not_pinned_by_registry_v1.recommendation: Record task_population_compatibility per system alongside comparator_class so the gates are checked separately rather than conflated.

same_substrate_exclusion.statement: Its strongest published agent is Claude Code, which is ORION's own harness. Any ORION result there is a same-substrate comparison and is not an independent architecture arm, regardless of comparator class.
same_substrate_exclusion.character: permanent scope label, not an engineering blocker

mechanic_assessment.registry_status: highest-value infrastructure adoption in v1; independent_evidence NONE - not yet adopted
mechanic_assessment.registry_argument: qualitative - a controlled retrieval environment is what makes a literature-route arm causal rather than confounded by corpus access

new_quantitative_argument.finding: Under externally anchored evidence-availability rates (arXiv:2608.05179: 83% code, 38% seeds/traces), fail-closed governed acceptance carries a throughput tax of 0.897 to 1.000. A 12-gate contract needs per-gate availability 0.9816 for a 20% tax and 0.9913 for a 10% tax.
new_quantitative_argument.implication: A controlled evidence/retrieval environment is not only what makes the comparison fair; it is what gives ORION's governance layer an operable regime at all. Availability is the binding parameter and an uncontrolled environment sits roughly two orders of magnitude below the requirement.
new_quantitative_argument.status_change: methodological preference -> quantified precondition with a falsifiable target (per-gate availability > 0.98)

mechanic_assessment.caveat: The Asta registry entry is SEARCH_SNIPPET grade. Whether the Asta Environment actually delivers a controlled corpus with the required properties is CANNOT_CHECK until read at primary depth. The requirement is quantified; the fit of this instrument to it is not yet evidence.

ordered_unblock_path.action: read primary full text for the four eligible systems; fill architecture fields from primaries only
record task_population_compatibility per system, separate from comparator_class
settle flagged chronology anchors arXiv:2606.07591 and arXiv:2608.05179 against the publisher record
read the Asta Environment at primary depth; decide MEC-CONTROLLED_RETRIEVAL_ENVIRONMENT adoption against the 0.98 availability target
scope adapters, only for systems passing BOTH gates
continue saturation rounds and run the operator-order perturbation audit; registry saturation is OPEN with zero flat rounds, so no completeness claim is available

what_must_not_be_promoted: This is a readiness verdict, not a comparison. No ORION-versus-anything result exists.
'No external comparison is runnable at causal grade' describes our current evidence, not the quality or availability of those systems.
The 0.9816 availability requirement is derived from a synthetic 12-gate population and does not transfer to real research populations without a separate study.
No completeness claim about the external landscape; registry saturation is OPEN.
